metadata.title: China's Financial Circuit: Yongqing with Wang Li on the Five Essays

conclusion: Yongqing wants a 5–10 year move: wealth still rises, deposit rates fall, money leaves the bank book for equities and insurance — the US 1980s analog. Wang Li (SOE and smaller banks, sub-branch to HQ) wrote the five finance essays plus property and LGFV as history, not a sin. He sketches 50–60% of credit still on a bank channel; UK banks put ~4% into corporates. HS300 is cheap; Moutai 16–20x with tiny fund ownership. ICBC is the old circuit; Wells Fargo is the named US case.
background: E206, Aug 23. Book title on the whisper tape is 自身业内 — seven chapters on the five finance essays plus property and LGFV. Wang has been a sub-branch and branch president at both SOE and smaller banks. Yongqing wants a 5–10 year deposit-to-equity pipe, not a strategist slide. ICBC is the old circuit; Wells Fargo is the named US letter; Moutai is the empty-fund old-light print. Quotes below are the audible strings.
important_facts: The 5–10 year claim: deposits will not keep the household as rates fall. Equities and insurance are the receiving pipes. US 1980s is the named rhyme — slower growth, older savers, more need for a return. Wang wrote because he could find single-essay books (green, digital) but not one file on all five plus the property/LGFV side. Chapters 1–5 are the essays; 6 is real-estate and local-government debt as infrastructure finance that built the roads you still walk, not only a bad residual.

Stock of the old circuit: 50–60% of credit still sketched as bank loans in his 20-year cartoon; another line on the tape puts 60–70% on that channel. UK banks at ~4% corporate loans is the contrast. That is why ICBC-class balance sheets are the starting ticker and why Wells Fargo (Buffett letter, retail-bank case) is the named US compare, not a growth multiple. Household and personal loans look weak — 'too much money, too few projects.'

Cheap risk assets: HS300 low; old-light Moutai/Eastroc/Midea with tiny public-fund holdings; AI and optics 'confused' and expensive. A 10% grower in a calm compounder is the thought experiment next to A500 vol. Digital finance is one of the five essays. Diligence the deposit-to-equity pipe, not a one-year bank NIM. Public-fund AUM grew fast while old-light holdings stayed tiny — that is the empty-fund print next to Moutai at 16–20x. Wang names smaller excellent-student banks (Taizhou-class) as well as the big SOE book. Insurance may take the first mark-to-market hit; banks still hold the loan stock. Wells Fargo is the named US retail-bank letter on the tape. The 5–10 year claim is the household leaving a 1% deposit for equities, insurance, and funds.

mental_model.name: Deposit Exit × Five Essays × Cheap HS300
mental_model.components: Rates down, wealth up, 5–10 years out of the bank book. Five official essays plus property/LGFV as history. 50–70% credit still bank-shaped versus UK ~4% corporate. HS300 and 16–20x Moutai are the empty-fund print. Digital is one essay. Wang wrote because single-essay books on green or digital exist, but not one file on all five plus the property/LGFV side that built the roads. Chapters 1–5 are official; chapter 6 is infrastructure finance, not a residual sin. Household and personal loans look weak — too much money, too few projects — which is why deposits can leave and HS300 can still sit empty. Moutai at 16–20x with tiny mutual-fund ownership is that empty-fund print. Wells Fargo is the named US retail-bank case on the tape; ICBC is the stock of the old 50–70% loan cartoon.
mental_model.application: 1398.HK is the old circuit. WFC is the named US bank case. 600519.SZ is the empty-fund old-light print. Do not buy every bank because deposits might leave.

key_insights.view: The household will leave the passbook.
key_insights.question: What is the 5–10 year move?
key_insights.answer: Rates down, wealth up, US 1980s rhyme. Equities and insurance receive.

key_insights.question: Why a seventh chapter?
key_insights.answer: Property and LGFV built infrastructure. Wang will not file them only as a sin.

key_insights.question: Where is the money?
key_insights.answer: Not in Moutai 16–20x. AI/optics are the crowded exception. Banks still hold the loan stock.
